_comment: Clarity in the Quran (@ClarityInTheQuran, UC0eBu0ZXcF20pTAG3lUnPXA) packaging fix. Built 2026-08-17 from clarity/channel-diagnosis.md, rewritten 2026-09-15 from clarity/reference-benchmark.md. Applied by automation/clarity_packaging.py.
_expect_channel_id: Enforced before any write: the script resolves the authenticated channel with mine=true and aborts unless it equals this. Three channels share this repo and one wrong token silently repackages the wrong one.
_tags_provenance: IMPORTANT — these tags were WRITTEN, not harvested. The diagnosis first claimed the 'RELATED SEARCHES' paragraph in each description could simply be moved into the tags field. Testing that on the real descriptions disproved it: those paragraphs are flowing prose, so a mechanical extract yields fragments like 'this video was made for you', 'this study goes deep into all of it' and 'or is it allowed to be rich in Islam', and QNlRJcyY4LU yields nothing at all. Bad tags are worse than none — they spend the 500-char field on noise. Each list below is hand-written from the video's actual subject, using the harvested phrases only as raw material.
_tag_budget: YouTube caps the entire tags field at 500 characters and rejects the whole update with `invalidTags` past it. A tag containing a space is sent quoted, costing two extra characters. clarity_packaging.py budgets 460 and drops overflow rather than failing the write.
_set_packaging: Title and/or tags for ONE video in ONE write. DESCRIPTIONS ARE NOT TOUCHED by any entry below — every field is optional, and leaving description out means clarity_crosslinks.py stays the only owner of description bodies, so a retitle can never drop a WATCH NEXT block. Every id in `protected` is refused. `expect_current_title` is the live title read on 2026-09-15; if a human has retitled since, the write skips instead of clobbering. Rewritten 2026-09-15 from clarity/reference-benchmark.md.

set_packaging.description:
"Fa inna ma'al usri yusra." For indeed, with hardship, there is ease. Surah Ash-Sharh 94:6 — the surah also called Al-Inshirah or Alam Nashrah, "The Relief".

Read it again, because the preposition is the whole verse. Allah did not say ease comes AFTER hardship. He said ma'a — WITH it. The relief is not waiting on the far side of what you are carrying. It is being woven while you carry it.

And it is said twice, back to back, in the same surah: 94:5 and 94:6. The same sentence, immediately repeated — once for the ears, once for the heart.

If you are in the middle of it right now, hold on. The ease is here.

#Quran #SurahAshSharh #IslamicReminder
tags: fa inna ma al usri yusra

set_packaging.description:
A Sunday league team signs a top-flight professional on loan, keeping match fit. Everyone assumes the same thing: he will drag the whole team up a level.

Twenty minutes in, he is everywhere, too fast — nobody can reach his passes, so he stops making them. By half time he is playing at their speed. Not because he got worse. Because nobody made him prove he was better.

That is not football. That is people.

Ibn al-Qayyim warned about the gathering that costs you nothing except your time and your heart. Lose the time, you lose the heart, and everything else goes with it.

Your friends are not bad people. They are loyal — they would come at 3am. They are just comfortable, and comfortable is contagious.

So tonight, one question, and it is not about them. Who do I become in that room?

And if someone in your life makes you faster, protect that.

#Quran #IbnAlQayyim #IslamicReminder

channel._why: Two channel-level surfaces, both reverse-engineered from @deepmadesimple on 2026-08-24 (clarity/growth-playbook.md). KEYWORDS: the reference carries ~70 tokens; Clarity carried 33 in 258 characters against YouTube's 500-character cap — the third pass flagged the gap and left it for the next packaging run. This is that run. The added terms are the named entities this niche is actually searched by (surah names: 'surah al kahf' alone is 190,340 searches/month on vidIQ, 'surah kahf' 978,793), which is the one class of term the old list had none of. DESCRIPTION: the old text is @deepmadesimple's About with the nouns swapped — the same substitution that produced the 'the cross is not the answer' line removed from cjtKWsFZbcg on 17 August. It is the largest un-audited derived asset on the channel, and the standing rule after that leak is to audit for the register, not for the one line already found. The replacement also drops a cadence promise the channel does not keep ('New videos every week'), states the format actually being run (long-form), and names surahs.
channel._expect_description_contains: Guard, re-pointed 2026-09-15. The previous guard looked for “It doesn’t have to be complicated” — the transposed line from the source channel’s About text — which the 24 August run already removed, so it would now skip every write. This fragment is the false series promise itself: it is in the live description today and it is exactly what this rewrite deletes, so the guard matches once and never again.
channel._why_description: The description advertises 'verse-by-verse studies — Surah Al-Kahf, Al-Mulk, Ya-Sin, Ar-Ra'd, Al-Fatihah'. Checked against the live catalogue on 2026-09-15: no upload's title contains Al-Kahf, Al-Mulk, Ya-Sin or Al-Fatihah. Four of the five named series do not exist. That is the channel's front door promising work it cannot show, to the exact visitor who came to check whether this channel is real. Rewritten to list what is actually published — the word studies, the three named verse studies, the emotions cluster — and nothing else.
channel.description:
Every video takes one verse, one Arabic word, or one surah and goes all the way down: what the Arabic actually says, where the mufassirun disagree, and what changes once you know.

Long-form only. No jargon, no highlight reels, no rulings — a study you can follow with no Arabic and no background, and still learn from if you have both.

📖 One Arabic word taken to its root — sabr, huzn, ajal, kazm — and what the English translation loses
📖 Verse studies: Surah Ar-Ra'd 28, Surah Al-Isra 23, Surah Al-Qalam
📖 What the Quran says about what people actually struggle with — anger, anxiety, depression, provision

How these are made: the Arabic on screen is set from a verified mushaf, every verse is cited by surah and ayah, and a scholarly disagreement is named rather than smoothed over. This channel explains; it issues no ruling.

If you have ever sat through a Quran class and thought “I have no idea what they are talking about” — start anywhere.

protected._why: Never repackage a proven winner. These five carry 4,076 of the channel's 4,805 lifetime views (2026-09-15). Their TITLES and DESCRIPTION BODIES must not move — retitling a settled video measured +0 views over 21.7 hours on channel 1, and that finding is about how YouTube treats settled videos rather than about any channel's subject. Adding tags to them is safe and additive; the one description edit below is a defect repair on a specific line, not a rewrite. 5Fb1iERyIhs was added 2026-09-15: the 17 Aug config had it queued for a retitle when it was a 3-view upload, and it has since become 2,400 views — 50% of the entire channel. Its set_packaging entry is retired to set_tags, which also lands the 24 tags that entry never applied (the title had drifted, so the whole entry aborted before the tag write).

deferred._why: Named here so they are not silently dropped. Each needs a human decision or content this repo does not have.
items: channel banner — banner: [] is empty. An image asset, not a metadata write.
captions — hasCaption: false on every upload. A production step, not a packaging one.
cadence — one long-form per week at the 16 August standard. The actual growth lever, and not something a script can do.
